designationHistory.indexText: With local and state support, the Pee Dee National Wildlife Refuge in Anson and Richmond Counties, North Carolina, was established to provide wintering habitat for migratory waterfowl.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Migratory Bird Conservation Act)
